get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of opened (not yet closed) daily checkout balances filtered by balance identifier, establishment, checkout, and balance date. Returns 200 with empty content when no results match the filters.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of opened daily balances (empty content if no matches)

400.description: Invalid request parameters — pagination out of bounds

value.message: Page number must be greater than zero

500.description: Internal server error — an unexpected error occurred

post.summary: Opens a new daily balance for the specified checkout. The checkout must exist and there must not be an existing open balance for the same date. Delegates to PKG_TIE_CHECKOUT.OPEN_CHECKOUT stored procedure.
post.description: Opens a new daily balance for the specified checkout. The checkout must exist and there must not be an existing open balance for the same date. Delegates to PKG_TIE_CHECKOUT.OPEN_CHECKOUT stored procedure.

201.description: Successfully opened a new daily balance

400.description: Invalid request parameters — missing or malformed fields

404.description: Checkout not found for the given identifier

409.description: A daily balance is already open for this checkout and date

value.message: It is not possible to open the balance. There is already a balance open for this checkout with this date

415.description: Unsupported media type. Only application/json is supported

422.description: Business validation error — the request violates checkout business rules

value.message: Checkout operation failed: It is not possible to open a daily balance with this date

500.description: Internal server error — an unexpected error occurred

post.summary: Closes an existing opened daily balance. The balance can be identified by balanceId alone or by checkoutId and balanceDate together. Delegates to PKG_TIE_CHECKOUT.CLOSE_CHECKOUT stored procedure.
post.description: Closes an existing opened daily balance. The balance can be identified by balanceId alone or by checkoutId and balanceDate together. Delegates to PKG_TIE_CHECKOUT.CLOSE_CHECKOUT stored procedure.

400.description: Invalid request parameters — missing required fields

value.message: Either balanceId or both checkoutId and balanceDate must be provided

404.description: No open daily balance found for the given parameters

value.message: There is no open balance in Tasy

415.description: Unsupported media type. Only application/json is supported

422.description: Business validation error — the request violates checkout closing rules

value.message: Checkout operation failed: The balance was already closed!

500.description: Internal server error — an unexpected error occurred
